course_id: Tiếng Anh – Kỹ năng Đọc Viết 2
title: English - Reading and Writing Skills 2

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to expand their vocabulary and apply it effectively in various contexts.
Students will develop the ability to understand and interpret complex texts at a B2 level according to the European Framework.
Students will learn to write academic essays with proper structure and logical flow.
Students will enhance their ability to analyze and evaluate arguments critically.

prerequisite_courses: Tiếng Anh – Kỹ năng Đọc Viết 1
